items.articleText: Ali Koç: Enerji dönüşümü artık tercih değil, ekonomik mecburiyet - Koç Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ali Koç, enerji dönüşümünün ülkelerin bağımsızlığını ve rekabet gücünü belirleyen ekonomik bir zorunluluğa dönüştüğünü söyledi. - Türkiye’nin Made in Europe kapsamı dışında kalması ihtimaline ilişkin “En kötü senaryoya hazırlıklı olmamız lazım” diyen Koç, enerji dönüşümünün Türkiye’ye önemli fırsatlar sunduğunu vurguladı. - CEO Levent Çakıroğlu ise topluluğun son beş yılda 17,5 milyar dolarlık yatırım yaptığını açıkladı. Koç Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ali Koç ve CEO Levent Çakıroğlu, Antalya’da COP31 kapsamında düzenlenen basın sohbetinde enerji dönüşümü, Avrupa’yla ticaret ve topluluğun yatırım planlarına ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İklim mücadelesinde hedeflerden uygulamaya geçilmesi gerektiğini belirten Ali Koç, “Artık daha yeni hedeflere ihtiyaç yok. Ne yapılması gerektiği belli” dedi. Koç, “Artık yeter, konuşmayın, eylem yapın” dönemine gelinmesinin Türkiye için büyük bir fırsat sunduğunu ifade etti. COP31’in Türkiye’nin enerji vizyonunu vitrine koyması açısından da önemli bir buluşma olduğunu söyleyen Koç, organizasyonun hazırlık çalışmalarını takdir ettiğini belirtti. “İklim hedefleri ekonomik yarışa döndü” Rusya-Ukrayna Savaşı ve Hürmüz krizinin enerji güvenliğinin önemini artırdığını vurgulayan Koç, enerji maliyetlerindeki yükselişin enflasyondan seçim sonuçlarına kadar geniş bir alanda etkili olduğunu söyledi. Koç, Hürmüz krizinin ardından Türkiye’nin aylık enerji maliyetinin yüzde 49 arttığını belirterek enerji dönüşümünü şu sözlerle değerlendirdi: “Enerji dönüşümünün formülü enerji bağımsızlığı artı ekonomik rekabetçilik. Şimdi dünyada iklim hedefleri ekonomik yarışa döndü.” Yenilenebilir enerji ve elektrifikasyona yönelişin ekonomik gerekçelerle güçlendiğini ifade eden Koç, “Artık mecburiyet, tercih değil, ekonomik açıdan bir mecburiyet” dedi. Koç, Avrupa’nın regülasyon ve karbon fiyatlamasıyla, Çin’in ise ölçek, teknoloji ve devlet desteğiyle öne çıktığını söyledi. Kritik minerallerin ve bu minerallerin işlenmesine yönelik kapasitenin de yeni dönemin stratejik rekabet alanları arasında bulunduğunu belirtti. “Dünyada para gidecek yer arıyor, niye bize gelmesin?” Türkiye’nin enerji dönüşümünde önemli fırsatlara sahip olduğunu belirten Koç, bu dönüşümün başarısında liderliğin ve içinde bulunulan ekosistemin önemini vurguladı. Koç, “Dünyada o kadar çok para var ki. Para gidecek yer arıyor. Niye bize gelmesin? Bizde helva yapacak unu, şekeri, malzemesi hepsi var. Olay onu bir araya getirebilmek” ifadelerini kullandı. Türkiye’nin enerji ihtiyacının yaklaşık üçte ikisinde dışa bağımlı olduğunu söyleyen Koç, gerçekçi, uygulanabilir ve finanse edilebilir bir enerji stratejisiyle ülkenin 10 yıl sonra çok farklı bir noktaya ulaşabileceğini belirtti. Koç, Türkiye’nin mühendislik kapasitesine, sanayisinin gelişimine ve bulunduğu bölgenin ihtiyaçlarına dikkat çekerek, “Bu dönüşümün değer zincirinde bir pozisyon alma imkânımız fazlasıyla var” dedi. Made in Europe uyarısı: “En kötü senaryoya hazırlıklı olmamız lazım” Türkiye’nin Made in Europe yaklaşımının dışında kalması ihtimaline ilişkin soruyu yanıtlayan Koç, böyle bir kararın otomotiv sanayisini ve karşılıklı ticareti derinden etkileyebileceğini söyledi. Türkiye ile Avrupa arasındaki güçlü otomotiv ilişkisine dikkat çeken Koç, olası dışlanmanın 30 yıllık kazan-kazan ilişkisini kaybet-kaybet düzeyine getirebileceğini ifade etti. Koç, değerlendirmesini şöyle sürdürdü: “En kötü senaryoya hazırlıklı olmamız lazım. İnşallah Avrupa’nın o akıl tutulması, yerini aklıselime bırakır.” Sektör oyuncularının kendilerini yeniden konumlandırdığını, kendilerinin de bunu yaptığını belirten Koç, ilişkinin zayıflamak yerine güçlenmesini umduğunu söyledi. Türkiye’nin ihracatında Avrupa’nın ağırlığına dikkat çeken Koç, dışlanmanın telafisi güç sonuçlar doğurabileceğini belirtti. Avrupa’da ülkeler ve siyasetçiler arasında görüş ayrılıkları bulunduğunu belirten Çakıroğlu, kamu alımlarının kritik bir başlık olduğunu ifade etti. Çakıroğlu, “Kamu alımları konusunda mütekabiliyet olmadan Türkiye’nin bu tarife dahil edilmesi mümkün gözükmüyor. Bu çok net ifade ediliyor” dedi. Türkiye’nin bu konuda harekete geçtiğini belirten Çakıroğlu, bir müzakere sürecinin başladığını bildiğini söyledi. “Karbon için ödenecek para Türkiye’de kalsın” Ali Koç, karbon fiyatlamasının da Türkiye sanayisinin rekabet gücü açısından daha fazla tartışılması gerektiğini belirtti. Avrupa’daki karbon düzenlemelerinin bazı sektörler için önemli maliyet riski yarattığını söyleyen Koç, Türkiye’de geliştirilen sistemin Avrupa’yla uyumunun önemine işaret etti. “Bizim sistemimiz Avrupa’ya uyumlu olabilmeli ki onun sınırında ödeyeceğimiz para ülkemizde kalsın” diyen Koç, yenilenebilir enerji kullanımının üretimin karbon ayak izini düşürerek rekabet gücünü destekleyebileceğini ifade etti. Türkiye’nin kendi güneşini, rüzgârını ve suyunu kullanarak dışa bağımlılığını azaltması gerektiğini vurgulayan Koç, enerji bağımsızlığını milli güvenliğin bir unsuru olarak gördüğünü söyledi. Çakıroğlu da özellikle enerji yoğun sektörlerde dışa bağımlılığın azalmasının yatırımların daha güvenli yapılmasına katkı sağlayacağını belirterek, “Enerji konusundaki bağımsızlığı hakikaten milli güvenlikten ayrı düşünmek çok kolay değil” dedi. Çin’le yenilenebilir enerjide finansman iş birliği mesajı Çin’in yenilenebilir enerji teknolojilerinde büyük bir üretim kapasitesi oluşturduğunu belirten Koç, ülkenin teknoloji, mühendislik ve finansmanı birlikte sunmasının önemli bir rekabet avantajı sağladığını söyledi. Türkiye’de finansman maliyetlerinin yüksek olduğuna dikkat çeken Koç, Çin’le özellikle yenilenebilir enerji alanında finansman odaklı iş birliklerinin değerlendirilebileceğini ifade etti. Koç, “Dolayısıyla Çin’de fırsat yatırımdan ziyade onların finansmanlarından yararlanmak. Ülkemizde finansman şu anda çok pahalı. İş birliği yapılabilir diye düşünüyorum” dedi. Bu iş birliğinin özellikle yenilenebilir enerjide değerlendirilebileceğini söyledi. Kalan kapasitenin de aşamalı olarak devreye alınacağını söyledi. Çakıroğlu; Arçelik’in Türkiye operasyonları, Ford Otosan, TürkTraktör, Entek, Yapı Kredi ve Otokoç’un kullandıkları enerjinin tamamını yenilenebilir kaynaklardan temin ettiğini belirtti. Tüpraş’ın karbon ayak izini azaltmak amacıyla Entek üzerinden yenilenebilir enerji yatırımlarını sürdürdüklerini anlatan Çakıroğlu, Entek’in mevcut 478 MW yenilenebilir enerji kapasitesini 2027 sonunda 827 MW’a çıkarmayı planladıklarını söyledi. Çakıroğlu, kapasiteyi 2030’da 1,6 GW’a, 2035’te ise 2,5 GW’a yükseltmeyi hedeflediklerini belirterek hem Türkiye’de hem de Türkiye dışında yatırımları bulunduğunu ifade etti. “Son beş yılda 17,5 milyar dolar yatırım yaptık” Çakıroğlu, enerji yatırımlarının yanında otomotivde elektrifikasyon çalışmalarının da sürdüğünü söyledi. Ford Otosan’ın elektrikli araçlarını, ağır kamyonların elektrifikasyonuna yönelik çalışmalarını, Otokar’ın elektrikli otobüsünü ve hidrojen yakıtlı otobüs prototipini örnek gösterdi. WAT Mobilite’nin elektrikli araç şarj ağına da değindi. Çakıroğlu, “Geçtiğimiz beş yılda 17,5 milyar dolar seviyesinde yatırım yaptık. Ülkemize güveniyoruz. Ülkemizin potansiyeline inanıyoruz” diyerek fırsat gördükleri yatırımları yapmaktan çekinmediklerini vurguladı. “Ülkemiz dışında da değer zinciri oluşturmamız gerekiyor” Ali Koç da yaz aylarında Türkiye’ye 425 milyon dolar kaynak getirdiklerini söyledi. Tofaş’ın geleceği açısından önemli gördükleri K9 üretim tesisi ile Arçelik’in Manisa’daki fabrikasına değinen Koç, “Ülkemiz kadar ülkemiz dışında da değer zinciri oluşturmamız gerekiyor” dedi. Koç, bazı şirket ve kurumların üretmeye, yatırım yapmaya ve istihdam yaratmaya var gücüyle devam ettiğini vurgulayarak, “İnşallah ikinci yüzyılımız birinci yüzyılımızdan daha parlak olur” ifadelerini kullandı. Tüpraş’a toplam 8,5 milyar dolar yatırım Tüpraş’ın topluluğun büyük yatırım yapan şirketlerinden biri olduğunu belirten Koç, bu yatırımlar sayesinde kriz döneminde tam kapasite çalışabildiklerini söyledi. Koç, “Biz enerji güvenliğine büyük önem veriyoruz, bütün yatırımlarımız sayesinde yüzde 100 kapasitemizi kullandık” dedi. Çakıroğlu ise Tüpraş’a bugüne kadar toplam 8,5 milyar dolar yatırım yaptıklarını açıkladı.

items.articleText: Koç Holding son beş yılda 17,5 milyar dolar yatırım yaptı - Koç Holding CEO’su Levent Çakıroğlu, topluluğun son beş yılda 17,5 milyar dolarlık yatırım yaptığını belirterek, “Ülkemize güveniyoruz. Ülkemizin potansiyeline inanıyoruz” dedi. - Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ali Koç ise yaz aylarında Türkiye’ye 425 milyon dolar kaynak getirdiklerini söyledi. Koç Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ali Koç ve CEO Levent Çakıroğlu, Antalya’da COP31 kapsamında düzenlenen basın sohbetinde topluluğun yatırımlarını ve büyüme planlarını değerlendirdi. Çakıroğlu, büyüme fırsatı ve sürdürülebilir rekabet avantajı gördükleri alanlarda yatırım yapmayı sürdürdüklerini belirtirken Ali Koç, Türkiye’de ve yurt dışında değer zincirleri oluşturmanın önemini vurguladı. “Gördüğümüz yatırımları yapmaktan çekinmiyoruz” CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Topluluğun mevcut faaliyetlerini ve yeni iş alanlarını sürekli değerlendirdiğini belirten Çakıroğlu, şöyle konuştu: “Herhangi bir konuda bir büyüme fırsatı, sürdürülebilir rekabetçi avantaj görürsek tabii ki yatırım yaparız. Zaten biliyorsunuz çok yatırım yapan bir topluluğuz. Geçtiğimiz beş yılda 17,5 milyar dolar seviyesinde yatırım yaptık. Ülkemize güveniyoruz. Ülkemizin potansiyeline inanıyoruz. Dolayısıyla da gördüğümüz yatırımları yapmaktan çekinmiyoruz.” Güneş paneli hücresi ve rüzgâr türbini yatırımı gibi konularda ise henüz belirlenmiş bir kararları bulunmadığını ifade etti. Ali Koç: Türkiye’ye 425 milyon dolar kaynak getirdik Ali Koç, yaz aylarında Türkiye’ye 425 milyon dolar kaynak getirdiklerini söyledi. Tofaş’ın K9 üretim tesisinin açılışına değinen Koç, bunun şirketin geleceği açısından çok önemli bir proje olduğunu belirtti. Arçelik’in Manisa’daki fabrikasına da dikkat çeken Koç, “Ülkemiz kadar ülkemiz dışında da değer zinciri oluşturmamız gerekiyor” dedi. Üretim, yatırım ve istihdamın sürdüğünü vurgulayan Koç, “Bazı şirketler, kurumlar üretmeye, yatırım yapmaya, istihdam yaratmaya var gücüyle devam ediyor. İnşallah ikinci yüzyılımız birinci yüzyılımızdan daha parlak olur” ifadelerini kullandı. Yenilenebilir enerjide kapasite artışı Çakıroğlu, topluluğun öz tüketim kapsamındaki lisanslarının toplamının yaklaşık 540 MW olduğunu, bunun 200 MW’tan fazlasını tamamladıklarını açıkladı. Kalan kapasitenin de aşamalı olarak devreye alınacağını belirtti. Tüpraş’ın karbon ayak izini azaltmak amacıyla Entek üzerinden yenilenebilir enerji yatırımlarını sürdürdüklerini söyleyen Çakıroğlu, Entek’in mevcut 478 MW yenilenebilir enerji kapasitesini 2027 sonunda 827 MW’a çıkarmayı planladıklarını bildirdi. Çakıroğlu, kapasiteyi 2030’da 1,6 GW’a, 2035’te ise 2,5 GW’a yükseltmeyi hedeflediklerini, bu kapsamda hem Türkiye’de hem de yurt dışında yatırımları bulunduğunu söyledi. Otomotivde elektrifikasyon çalışmaları sürüyor Çakıroğlu, ürettikleri araçların elektrifikasyonunun da önemli bir yatırım alanı olduğunu belirtti. Ford Otosan’ın elektrikli araçlarının piyasada bulunduğunu, ağır kamyonların elektrifikasyonuna yönelik çalışmaların sürdüğünü söyledi. Otokar’ın tamamen elektrikli otobüsünün yanı sıra hidrojen yakıtlı otobüs prototipi de geliştirdiğini belirten Çakıroğlu, WAT Mobilite’nin elektrikli araç şarj ağına da değindi. Tüpraş’a toplam 8,5 milyar dolar yatırım Ali Koç, Tüpraş’ın topluluğun büyük yatırım yapan şirketlerinden biri olduğunu belirterek bu yatırımların kriz döneminde Türkiye’nin enerji arzına katkı sağladığını ifade etti. Tüpraş’ın tam kapasite çalışmasının önemini vurgulayan Koç, “Biz enerji güvenliğine büyük önem veriyoruz, bütün yatırımlarımız sayesinde yüzde 100 kapasitemizi kullandık” dedi. Çakıroğlu da Tüpraş’a bugüne kadar toplam 8,5 milyar dolar yatırım yaptıklarını açıkladı.

items.title: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain
items.summary: As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain
items.summaryTr: As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities.
items.articleText: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities. Bitcoin miners with power already secured could have an edge in the race to build AI data centers after voters in several US communities backed limits on new development. The midterms could also bring closer scrutiny from Congress over who pays for the grid upgrades those facilities need, industry experts told Cointelegraph. Voters in several states weighed in on data center development during the Nov. 3 US midterms, when local measures appeared on the same ballots as congressional races. Amid concerns about rising electricity costs, water use and the impact on nearby communities, voters favored limiting development in 40 of the 41 local contests tracked by Ballotpedia. The restrictions include citywide bans, limits on larger facilities, temporary pauses on new projects and voter approval requirements for some developments. The results come as major Bitcoin mining companies continue moving into AI, a transition Jamie Brown, CEO of Global Kiwi Labs, said could become more attractive as local restrictions make it harder to build new data centers. “If a Bitcoin miner has not yet repurposed their electric contract and physical plant to AI, the case to do so just got more compelling,” said Brown, whose company hosts servers for crypto exchanges and trading firms. Related: US midterm elections 2026 as it happened: Democrats win control of Congress Local restrictions make expansion harder Miners’ shift to AI infrastructure is already underway, with publicly listed Bitcoin miners announcing more than $70 billion in AI and advanced computing contracts during 2025 and early 2026, according to a first-quarter report by CoinShares. But state and local decisions can have a more immediate impact on whether data center projects move forward. That’s because local authorities often oversee zoning and building permits and can influence access to electricity. “A company might have access to an attractive site and a significant amount of power capacity, but if local restrictions prevent it from expanding or upgrading that infrastructure, the opportunity becomes much more difficult to pursue,” said Jordan Knecht, head of strategic integrations at Kresus, a blockchain infrastructure company. Last week, voters backed 27 measures to limit or oppose new data centers in the elections, according to Ballotpedia. These included five complete bans, 12 partial bans and six-month pauses on new projects in three Maine towns. In Grove City, Ohio, voters approved a rule requiring public approval for large projects that use more than 20 megawatts of electricity, among other conditions. “Federal policy will certainly influence the broader investment environment, but the practical ability to develop and operate these facilities often comes down to conditions in individual markets,” Knecht told Cointelegraph. “For miners looking to transition into AI, I think understanding those local dynamics will be just as important as following developments in Washington.” Expanding into AI is not that simple Building AI-ready data center infrastructure can cost between $8 million and $15 million per megawatt, compared with $700,000 to $1 million per megawatt for traditional mining facilities, according to a 2026 report by CoinShares. That gap helps explain why a site with power already secured is only a starting point for miners moving into AI. “Transitioning from Bitcoin mining to AI workloads requires significant additional investment in infrastructure for cooling, networking, and reliability,” Knecht said. Yuliya Barabash, founder of SBSB Fintech Lawyers, also pointed to differences in electricity needs between Bitcoin mining and AI data centers. Bitcoin miners can often reduce electricity use when prices rise, while AI data centers typically need a consistent power supply, she said. “Higher electricity prices and additional regulatory requirements could make some projects less profitable or delay their implementation,” Barabash told Cointelegraph. This comes as electricity demand from US data centers is also expected to rise, according to the International Energy Agency (IEA). The agency estimates that data centers used 224 terawatt-hours of electricity in 2025, a figure projected to nearly double to 426 terawatt-hours by 2030. The impact of Congressional changes One question facing the incoming Democratic-controlled Congress is who should pay to expand the grid for large data centers. Knecht said lawmakers could take a closer look at how those projects affect electricity costs and how they get approved. “There may be more pressure to ensure that large data center operators are paying their fair share of infrastructure costs rather than passing those expenses on to consumers.” Barabash also expects scrutiny of who pays for the electricity infrastructure needed to support data centers. “One of the key priorities is likely to be ensuring that technology companies, rather than ordinary consumers, bear the costs of the additional electricity infrastructure their facilities require,” she said. Still, experts noted that closer attention does not necessarily mean Congress will discourage data center development. “AI infrastructure is becoming increasingly important to the US economy, and there is still a strong incentive to support investment in domestic computing capacity,” Knecht said. For miners weighing a conversion, the question is whether AI revenue can justify the cost of upgrading cooling, networking and power systems. Brown thinks it can. “Miners will swap to AI because it is a better ROI than mining,” he said. Magazine: Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen

items.summaryTr: Siri'nin kurucu ortağı Dag Kittlaus, ses tabanlı kimlik doğrulama girişimi Helix'e danışman oldu. Kullanıcıların hassas bilgilerini paylaşmadan insan olduklarını doğrulamayı hedefleyen girişim, yatırım turunda 6,2 milyon dolar topladı.
items.articleText: Siri'nin kurucu ortağı sesle kimlik doğrulama girişimi Helix'e katıldı - Siri'nin kurucu ortağı Dag Kittlaus, ses tabanlı kimlik doğrulama girişimi Helix'e danışman oldu. Kullanıcıların hassas bilgilerini paylaşmadan insan olduklarını doğrulamayı hedefleyen girişim, yatırım turunda 6,2 milyon dolar topladı. Yapay zeka çağında internette gerçek kullanıcıları botlardan ayırmak giderek zorlaşırken, ses tabanlı kimlik doğrulama teknolojileri öne çıkıyor. Siri'nin kurucu ortağı Dag Kittlaus, kişisel bilgileri paylaşmadan kullanıcıların insan olduğunu doğrulamayı hedefleyen Helix girişimine danışman oldu. Şirket ayrıca yatırım turunda 6,2 milyon dolar fon topladı. Helix, CAPTCHA'nın yerini alabilecek mi? CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İnternet siteleri uzun yıllardır kullanıcıların insan olduğunu doğrulamak için CAPTCHA gibi teknolojilerden yararlanıyor. Sosyal medya platformları ise son dönemde fotoğraf ve video üzerinden kimlik doğrulama yöntemlerine yöneliyor. Helix, bu yöntemlerden farklı olarak ses tabanlı bir doğrulama sistemi geliştiriyor. Teknoloji, kullanıcıların hassas kişisel bilgilerini paylaşmasına gerek kalmadan insan olduklarını kanıtlamalarını amaçlıyor. Girişimin aldığı en dikkat çekici desteklerden biri de Siri'nin kurucu ortağı Dag Kittlaus'tan geldi. Kittlaus, Helix'in danışmanları arasında yer alacak. 6,2 milyon dolarlık yatırım aldı 2025 yılında Alex Oberg, Anna Dorofiyenko ve Mike Hall tarafından kurulan Helix, Chicago Ventures liderliğindeki yatırım turunda 6,2 milyon dolar fon topladı. Yatırım turuna BAM Ventures, Aglaé Ventures, Corazon Capital, Press On Ventures, Tusk Ventures, Yonder Ventures, Rule 30 ve Brown Angel Group da katıldı. Kurucu ekibin teknoloji ve dijital platformlar alanında farklı deneyimleri bulunuyor. Oberg, daha önce Ticketmaster'da çalıştı ve platformun botlarla mücadele etmek amacıyla geliştirdiği Verified Fan sisteminde görev aldı. Dorofiyenko, Live Nation ve Zillow'da veri bilimi ekiplerine liderlik etti. Hall ise Nike ve Tinder'da çalıştı ve Tinder'ın ilk eşleştirme algoritmasının geliştirilmesine katkıda bulundu. items.title: African writing award probe finds 'no evidence' winning story was AI generated
items.summary: Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza has also vehemently denied the allegation made in a US magazine.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: African writing award probe finds 'no evidence' winning story was AI generated
items.summaryTr: Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza has also vehemently denied the allegation made in a US magazine.
items.articleText: African writing award probe finds 'no evidence' winning story was AI generated - Published The Caine Prize for African Writing has said that after an internal review it has found no evidence that Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza had used generative AI to write his winning short story and confirmed him as the winner of this year's £10,000 ($13,000) award. Ellah Wakatama, chair of the Caine Prize's board of trustees, said the matter had been investigated following an article in US magazine The Atlantic with the headline, Yet Another Literary Prizewinner Seems to Be AI. "From our detailed investigation, we feel the evidence is clear: The Blue Fighter was human written," she said in a video posted on X. The accusation had caused a social media uproar and Kundizeza had denied the allegation. The Atlantic article by journalist Vauhini Vara alleged that AI-detection software Pangram had shown his work about a boy whose family falls on hard times was entirely AI generated. Her allegations followed rows over other literary prizes this year, in particular the Commonwealth Short Story Prize, which was won by Trinidadian writer Jamir Nazir despite allegations that he had used AI, and the withdrawal of Canadian-Haitian author Thélyson Orélien from France's top literary award, the Goncourt, over allegations he used AI for his first novel, which he denies. Following the publication of her article last month, Vara had told BBC's Front Row programme that every other previous Caine Prize winning story she had put through Pangram "came out as 100% human". The backlash on social media included comments from African writers with suggestions that such accusations are primarily being made against non-white writers. - Zimbabwean author denies using AI to write award-winning story - Published14 October Wakatama said the Caine Prize organisation had considered Vara's allegations "carefully and fairly". "We chose to take a human-centred approach to the investigation. Our review included interviews with the author, the 2026 judging panel, and the Shallow Tales Review, where the story was first published," she said. "It also included independent and expert-led metadata analysis of drafts written by the author." In a statement, the Caine Prize explained further that the analysis had been conducted by an independent cyber security and digital forensic investigator, external. The day after winning the prestigious Caine Prize award earlier in October, Kundizeza had told the BBC he was inspired after hearing a poem read by South African Vangile Gantsho at an event in Ghana last year about her father's obsession with building fish tanks. He said he had weaved that with fictionalised details from his own life around 2002 when Zimbabwe's economic troubles began. items.summary: TCMB, ihtiyaç ve taşıt kredileri ile işletme kredilerinde sekiz haftalık büyüme sınırlarını 0,5 puan artırdı. Bankaların uzun vadeli mevduat dışı yükümlülükleri için tesis edilen zorunlu karşılıklara TL cinsinden faiz veya telafi ödemesi de yapılacak.

items.summaryTr: TCMB, ihtiyaç ve taşıt kredileri ile işletme kredilerinde sekiz haftalık büyüme sınırlarını 0,5 puan artırdı. Bankaların uzun vadeli mevduat dışı yükümlülükleri için tesis edilen zorunlu karşılıklara TL cinsinden faiz veya telafi ödemesi de yapılacak.
items.articleText: TCMB'den kredi büyümesine yeni ayar: İhtiyaç, taşıt ve KOBİ kredilerinde sınır yükseldi - TCMB, ihtiyaç ve taşıt kredileri ile işletme kredilerinde sekiz haftalık büyüme sınırlarını 0,5 puan artırdı. Bankaların uzun vadeli mevduat dışı yükümlülükleri için tesis edilen zorunlu karşılıklara TL cinsinden faiz veya telafi ödemesi de yapılacak. Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası (TCMB), kredi büyüme sınırlarında değişikliğe gitti. Yeni düzenlemeyle ihtiyaç ve taşıt kredilerinde sekiz haftalık büyüme sınırı yüzde 3'ten yüzde 3,5'e, KOBİ kredilerinde ise yüzde 5'ten yüzde 5,5'e çıkarıldı. KOBİ dışı işletme kredilerinde de sınır yüzde 2,5'e yükseltildi. İhtiyaç ve taşıt kredilerinde büyüme sınırı yüzde 3,5 oldu CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle TCMB'nin 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli ve 2026-49 sayılı basın duyurusuna göre, tüketicilere kullandırılan ihtiyaç kredilerinde sekiz haftalık kredi büyüme sınırı yüzde 3'ten yüzde 3,5'e çıkarıldı. Taşıt kredilerinde de aynı yönde değişikliğe gidildi. Böylece tüketici kredilerinde büyüme sınırı 0,5 puan artırılmış oldu. KOBİ kredilerinde de sınırlar yükseltildi Düzenleme kapsamında işletmelere kullandırılan Türk lirası kredilerinin büyüme sınırları da artırıldı. KOBİ'lere kullandırılan TL kredilerinde sekiz haftalık büyüme sınırı yüzde 5'ten yüzde 5,5'e yükseltildi. KOBİ dışı işletmelere kullandırılan TL kredilerinde ise sınır yüzde 2'den yüzde 2,5'e çıkarıldı. Böylece dört kredi kategorisinin tamamında büyüme sınırları 0,5 puan artırılmış oldu. Uzun vadeli yükümlülüklerin zorunlu karşılıklarına TL ödemesi TCMB'nin açıkladığı bir diğer değişiklik ise zorunlu karşılık uygulamasına ilişkin oldu. Bankaların ve finansman şirketlerinin bir yıldan uzun vadeli, Türk lirası ve yabancı para cinsinden mevduat dışı yükümlülükleri için tesis edilen zorunlu karşılıklara Türk lirası cinsinden faiz veya telafi ödemesi yapılmasına karar verildi. Merkez Bankası, değişikliklerin makrofinansal istikrarı ve parasal aktarım mekanizmasını desteklemek amacıyla gerçekleştirildiğini bildirdi. Kredi büyüme sınırlarında değişiklik

items.titleTr: Apple hisselerinde rekor rallisi! Yükseliş yüzde 30'a ulaşırken piyasalar hareketlendi
items.summaryTr: Apple hisseleri, 2026 başından bu yana yüzde 30 yükselerek tüm zamanların rekorunu kırdı. Çarşamba günü yaklaşık 900 bin opsiyon işlemi gerçekleşirken alım opsiyonlarının hacmi satım opsiyonlarını geride bıraktı.
items.articleText: Apple hisselerinde rekor rallisi! Yükseliş yüzde 30'a ulaşırken piyasalar hareketlendi - Apple hisseleri, 2026 başından bu yana yüzde 30 yükselerek tüm zamanların rekorunu kırdı. Çarşamba günü yaklaşık 900 bin opsiyon işlemi gerçekleşirken alım opsiyonlarının hacmi satım opsiyonlarını geride bıraktı. Apple hisseleri, teknoloji piyasasındaki sert satışlara ve faiz artışı endişelerine rağmen yükselişini sürdürerek tüm zamanların en yüksek seviyesine ulaştı. 2026 başından bu yana yüzde 30 değer kazanan hissede, opsiyon işlemlerinde de alım yönlü hareketlilik dikkat çekti. Apple hisselerinde rekor yükseliş CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle CNBC sunucusu Jim Cramer'ın sıkça dile getirdiği "Apple'a yatırım yaparsınız, al-sat yapmazsınız" yaklaşımı, şirket hisselerinin son performansıyla yeniden gündeme geldi. Apple hisseleri çarşamba günü yüzde 1,79 yükselerek 354,75 dolara ulaştı. Şirketin hisseleri, kısa süreli bilanço kaynaklı düşüşe rağmen geçen hafta Covid-19'dan bu yana teknoloji hisselerinde görülen en sert satış dalgasını, yarı iletken sektöründeki ayı piyasasını ve faiz artışı endişelerini geride bıraktı. Böylece Apple'ın 2026 yılındaki toplam yükselişi yüzde 30'a ulaştı ve hisse yeni bir rekor seviyeye çıktı. Opsiyon piyasasında alım yönlü hareketlilik Apple hisselerindeki dirençli görünüm, teknoloji sektöründe güvenli liman arayan opsiyon yatırımcılarının da dikkatini çekti. Çarşamba günü seansın ilk yarısında Apple hisseleri üzerinde yaklaşık 900 bin opsiyon işlemi gerçekleştirildi. Bunların yaklaşık 500 bini alım (call), 370 bini ise satım (put) opsiyonlarından oluştu. Yatırımcılar ayın başında şirketin bilançosu öncesinde satım opsiyonlarına yönelmişti. Ancak hisselerin yeniden yükselişe geçmesiyle put/call açık pozisyon oranı 0,95'ten 0,87'ye geriledi. Günlük işlem hacminde ise alım opsiyonları öne çıktı. Bu tablo, Apple hisselerindeki yükselişin opsiyon piyasasında da alım yönlü beklentileri güçlendirdiğine işaret ediyor.

items.summary: AB'nin Çin'den ithalata yönelik kuralları sıkılaştırma ve yerel üretimi destekleme adımları Arçelik'e avantaj sağlayabilir. Bloomberg'e göre şirket, Avrupa'daki fabrikaları sayesinde Çinli rakiplerine karşı daha güçlü konumda olmayı hedefliyor.

items.articleText: ABD medyası yazdı: Avrupa'nın yeni kuralları Türk beyaz eşya devine yarayabilir - AB'nin Çin'den ithalata yönelik kuralları sıkılaştırma ve yerel üretimi destekleme adımları Arçelik'e avantaj sağlayabilir. Bloomberg'e göre şirket, Avrupa'daki fabrikaları sayesinde Çinli rakiplerine karşı daha güçlü konumda olmayı hedefliyor. Avrupa Birliği'nin ithalatı sıkılaştırma ve yerel üretimi destekleme adımları, Türk ihracatçılar arasında endişe yaratırken Arçelik için fırsata dönüşebilir. Bloomberg'in haberine göre şirket, Avrupa'daki mevcut fabrikaları sayesinde Çinli rakiplerine karşı avantaj elde edebileceğini düşünüyor. Avrupa'daki fabrikalar Arçelik'in elini güçlendiriyor CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Arçelik'in küresel markası Beko'nun Finans Direktörü Barış Alparslan, Türkiye'deki rekabetçi üretim yapısı ve Avrupa'daki fabrikaların şirkete önemli avantaj sağladığını belirtti. Beko'nun Avrupa'da halihazırda üretim tesislerine sahip olması, şirketin yerel üretimi desteklemeyi amaçlayan yeni AB düzenlemelerine Çinli rakiplerinden daha kolay uyum sağlamasına imkan tanıyabilir. Alparslan, Beko'nun Avrupa'daki güçlü marka bilinirliğinin de rekabette önemli rol oynadığını ifade etti. Bu konumun şirketin fiyatlarını ve satış sonrası hizmetlerini koruyarak Çinli üreticilerle rekabet etmesine yardımcı olabileceği değerlendiriliyor. AB'nin yeni düzenlemeleri Türk ihracatçıları endişelendiriyor Avrupa Birliği, Çin'den yapılan ithalata bağımlılığı azaltmak ve Avrupa'daki üretimi güçlendirmek amacıyla yeni düzenlemeler üzerinde çalışıyor. Bu kapsamda, belirli ithal ürünlerin üretiminden kaynaklanan karbon emisyonlarını fiyatlandıran Sınırda Karbon Düzenleme Mekanizması (SKDM) ve Avrupa'da üretilen ürünleri desteklemeyi hedefleyen "Made in Europe" girişimi öne çıkıyor. Avrupa, Türkiye'nin en önemli ihracat pazarlarından biri olduğu için söz konusu düzenlemeler Türk üreticiler açısından pazara erişim ve rekabet koşullarına ilişkin soru işaretleri yaratıyor. Arçelik ise Avrupa'daki mevcut üretim tesisleri sayesinde yeni dönemde Çinli rakiplerinden ayrışabileceğini düşünüyor. Arçelik'in üçüncü çeyrek zararı iki katı aştı Şirket, Avrupa pazarındaki rekabetin yanı sıra Türkiye'deki yüksek faiz oranları ve zayıf tüketici talebinin baskısıyla karşı karşıya. Arçelik, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 6,21 milyar TL net zarar açıkladı. Şirketin net zararı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 2,67 milyar TL'ye kıyasla iki katından fazla arttı. Arçelik'in Beko dışında Whirlpool ve Grundig markaları da bulunuyor.

Arçelik'in üçüncü çeyrek zararı iki katı aştı Şirket, Avrupa pazarındaki rekabetin yanı sıra Türkiye'deki yüksek faiz oranları ve zayıf tüketici talebinin baskısıyla karşı karşıya. Arçelik, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 6,21 milyar TL net zarar açıkladı. Şirketin net zararı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 2,67 milyar TL'ye kıyasla iki katından fazla arttı. items.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
items.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
items.summaryTr: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.
items.articleText: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax - Published Some 6,300 schools across Italy and more than 700 in Scotland and Northern Ireland have received bomb threats, according to local authorities. In Italy a number of buildings were evacuated as a precaution but Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said checks so far had not indicated any evidence of "concrete danger". "These reports appear rather linked to a strategy intended to cause alarm and concern," she said on Facebook. Scotland's education secretary Mairi McAllan said there was no risk to the public and specialist cyber-crime officers were working to identify the source of the messages. In Northern Ireland education officials told schools to remain open unless otherwise advised by police. It is unclear whether the incidents are connected. "As a parent and as a constituency MSP I understand just how concerning this will be for parents, for pupils, for carers and for school staff," McAllan said. Scottish police had earlier said that the warnings were "immediately assessed" as hoaxes. However some local authorities confirmed that some schools had been evacuated. "Our advice is that there is no requirement to evacuate schools or keep children away from education based solely on the content of the emails," Police Scotland said. Italian officials said a single email appeared to have been sent on Wednesday to the inboxes of 6,300 out of a total of 7,476 state schools, and private schools were unaffected. The message, said to be from a certain "Mikhail Andropov, leader of Vilayat di Misoginistan", caused alarm in many schools. The BBC has seen the email sent to Scottish schools which appeared to have similar wording, and also referenced the name Mikhail Andropov, although as leader of a "Red Owl" project. Italy's Education Minister Giuseppe Valditara said the incidents involving Italian schools were probably a "cyber-attack, not a genuine risk", adding that there appeared to be a clear strategy behind the rash of threats in across Europe targeting flights, supermarkets and even hospitals. Italian airports along with airlines elsewhere in Europe were hit by a series of bomb hoaxes last week that prompted a series of scares, evacuations and widespread disruption. Although a number of threats were claimed by an extremist misogynistic group, it later denied any link to the false warnings. - No risk to public from hoax school bomb threats, says government minister - Published4 hours ago - Police treating threatening email sent to more than 300 schools as 'hoax' - Published6 hours ago On Wednesday one Milan headteacher, Anna Bertato, told Italian media she had checked the email address of the sender online: "It was already classified as spam by a student at a university in Taiwan." Another Milan headteacher, Massimo Nunzio Barrella, told Adnkronos news agency that he had immediately realised the email was spam when it arrived in his inbox at 08:59 and he decided not to evacuate his school and reassured parents who phoned in. "The text seemed almost comical," said Barrella, "it was like a message from Martians: 'We have come to annihilate you.' I even had a bit of a laugh." Although many schools were initially evacuated on Wednesday, the alarm was quickly lifted, and pupils were allowed to return to class. Some parents decided to take their children home for the day, but the majority of schools in Milan did not send their pupils home. Some 280 school head teachers had already received threats in recent days, according to Italian reports. In a statement, the head of the central Umbria region Stefania Proietti said "checks conducted so far in Umbrian schools have proved negative, and law enforcement is working rapidly and carefully to verify each report". Related topics - Published5 days ago

items.articleText: ABD borsasında roller değişti: Büyükler alıyor, küçükler satıyor - ABD borsalarında sert düşüşlerin ardından yatırımcıların stratejileri değişti. Bank of America verilerine göre, kurumsal yatırımcılar 6,1 milyar dolarlık alım yaparken bireysel yatırımcılar yaklaşık 2 milyar dolarlık satış gerçekleştirdi. ABD hisse senedi piyasalarında artan oynaklık, büyük yatırımcılarla bireysel yatırımcıların farklı yönlere hareket etmesine neden oldu. Bank of America'nın (BofA) yayımladığı verilere göre, son satış dalgasını fırsat olarak değerlendiren kurumsal yatırımcılar güçlü alımlara yönelirken bireysel yatırımcılar piyasadan çıkışlarını sürdürdü. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Bankanın verileri, kurumsal müşterilerin geçen hafta 6,1 milyar dolardan fazla hisse senedi satın aldığını ortaya koydu. Bu alımların yaklaşık 4 milyar dolarlık bölümünü hisse senedi borsa yatırım fonları (ETF) oluşturdu. Buna karşılık bireysel yatırımcılar üst üste dördüncü haftada da net satıcı konumunda kaldı. BofA'nın bireysel müşterileri aynı dönemde yaklaşık 2 milyar dolarlık hisse senedi sattı. Borsada alışılmış strateji tersine döndü Piyasalardaki bu ayrışma, son dönemde yatırımcı davranışlarında yaşanan değişime işaret ediyor. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın 2 Nisan 2025'te açıkladığı ve "Kurtuluş Günü" olarak adlandırdığı tarife kararlarından bu yana bireysel yatırımcılar, piyasalardaki sert düşüşleri alım fırsatı olarak değerlendiriyordu. Ancak son satış dalgasında bu eğilim tersine döndü. Demokratların ABD ara seçimlerinde Kongre'nin her iki kanadında da kontrolü ele geçirmesiyle artan siyasi belirsizlik ve yapay zeka şirketlerinin büyüme beklentilerine ilişkin endişeler, piyasalardaki dalgalanmayı artırdı. Özellikle son yıllarda ABD borsalarındaki yükselişe öncülük eden teknoloji ve yapay zeka hisselerinde yaşanan satışlar, yatırımcıların risk iştahını olumsuz etkiledi. Bireysel yatırımcılar piyasaya destek vermeyi bıraktı RBC Capital Markets Türev Stratejisi Başkanı Amy Wu Silverman, CNBC'ye yaptığı değerlendirmede bireysel yatırımcıların geçmişte piyasa düşüşlerinde dengeleyici rol üstlendiğini ancak bu durumun değiştiğini söyledi. Silverman, bireysel yatırımcıların daha önce düşüşlerde alım yaparak geniş piyasa için destek oluşturduğunu, son dönemde ise bu desteğin ortadan kalkmasının ötesinde ters yönde bir hareket yaşandığını belirtti. Özellikle opsiyon piyasasında bireysel yatırımcıların artan tedirginliğinin fiyat hareketlerini hızlandırdığını ifade eden Silverman, bu davranışın piyasanın diğer bölümlerinde de zincirleme etki yarattığını kaydetti. Gözler kurumsal yatırımcıların hamlelerinde Yapay zeka bağlantılı hisselerdeki satışların etkisiyle S&P 500 endeksi geçen perşembe günü yüzde 4 gerilerken Nasdaq Bileşik Endeksi düzeltme bölgesine girdi. Endeksler daha sonra kayıplarının bir bölümünü telafi etse de piyasalardaki belirsizlik devam ediyor. Wall Street'in korku göstergesi olarak bilinen Cboe Volatilite Endeksi (VIX), çarşamba günü 18 seviyesi civarında işlem gördü. Önümüzdeki dönemde kurumsal yatırımcıların alımlarını sürdürüp sürdürmeyeceği ve bireysel yatırımcıların yeniden piyasaya dönüp dönmeyeceği yakından izlenecek. İki yatırımcı grubu arasındaki ayrışmanın kalıcı hale gelmesi, ABD borsalarındaki fiyat hareketlerinin yönü açısından belirleyici olabilir.

items.title: Missing 11-month-old baby found buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
items.summary: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Missing 11-month-old baby found buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
items.summaryTr: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.
items.articleText: Missing 11-month-old baby found buried alive in a crate in South Carolina - Published An 11-month-old baby has been rescued in South Carolina after officials say he was buried alive in a crate by his father. Koah Sharpe had been missing since Monday when he was taken by his father, Michael Comer, 25, according to the Lexington County Sheriff's Department. Comer was arrested on a burglary charge on Monday evening but his son was not with him. The baby was found on Tuesday "buried alive" and "clinging to life" not far from his father's house, Lexington County Sheriff Jay Koon said at a news conference. It is thought he had been there for 24 hours. The child is now in hospital receiving care, Koon said, adding he was hopeful he would make a full recovery. Police are still deciding what further charges to bring against the father. The search for baby Koah began on Monday after his father took him from his mother's house. Comer's mother was watching the child and had left her son alone with him briefly, Koon said, when he left abruptly with Koah. Comer was seen travelling to multiple locations without the baby and was later arrested in Lexington County without Koah. A search party of 100 police and fire department officials were then sent to search for the child, the sheriff said. He added that when they asked Comer where his son was, he "did not have much to say" about his whereabouts. Koon said that rescuers searched the woods near Comer's house and saw some "freshly disturbed dirt". As they began to dig, they heard a baby crying - something the sheriff described as "the most joyful sound you ever heard". "The race was on. Everybody was getting down there trying to get him out," Koon added. He said the crate was wrapped in a towel that probably provided enough air for Koah to survive for as long as he did, while the cold weather kept him from getting too hot. "The crate was, probably, I'm guessing about a two-foot [61cm] by two-foot dog crate. So, I think, once that crate hit the ground, he was probably up at least a foot from the top of that crate to the top of the ground," Koon explained. Of the parents' relationship, the sheriff said there were "obviously some issues". Comer had previously pleaded guilty to domestic violence charges, court records show. Comer's mother, Patricia Comer, told NBC News that Koah's mother had full custody of him but allowed her to supervise while her son watched him. She said her son had watched the baby before unsupervised without any problems. "Honestly, I'm his mother, and I never expected this from him," Patricia Comer said.

items.titleTr: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
items.summaryTr: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.
items.articleText: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough - Published Trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine have concluded after a second day. Although the American side said they saw "some openings", there was no hint of any breakthroughs to end the nearly five year-long war sparked by Russia's invasion. However, both Moscow and Kyiv confirmed that a large-scale prisoner of war exchange was in the works and could be carried out soon. Davyd Arakhamia from Ukraine's negotiating team said that this round of talks - the first since February - "was one of the hardest." "I believe the Russians came with very strict directives, so it was extremely difficult to soften the discussion," he said. But he added that he felt "good momentum" and urged for a second round of talks to be organised as soon as possible. Comments by Kremlin negotiator Vladimir Medinsky were less conciliatory. "Right now... a lot depends on Ukraine, on the position of the US, and on whether Europe comes to its senses," he said. After the talks it was announced that on Thursday US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner - President Donald Trump's son-in-law - would travel to Moscow to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin, and then to Dublin to speak to Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky. The meetings in Abu Dhabi had been framed as centred around the "security architecture" of Europe. For Kyiv, this may include reassurances that allies will come to its aid if Ukraine comes under attack again, despite the country not being a Nato member. For Moscow, a reworked "security framework" is likely to include a limit to the influence of Nato in eastern Europe - a central concern for the Kremlin since the alliance's eastward expansion. Earlier this week Kushner said the US hoped to "create a new framework" of security between Ukraine, Russia and Europe that could "secure lasting peace", while the Kremlin's Medinsky said the world needed a "new" and "fair" security system. That framework would serve as "a new Yalta and Potsdam", Medinsky said, referring to the 1940s summits in which the victorious Allied powers carved up post-war Europe into spheres of influence. Ukraine and Europe have long been concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin. Representatives of Britain, Nato and various EU countries were also in Abu Dhabi and met with US and Ukrainian negotiators, but the Kremlin - with whom the EU does not officially communicate - said its delegation had not had any contact with them. Moscow has been dismissive of European involvement, although Europeans have long argued that they are central to any post-war dynamics on their continent. Many - particularly in eastern Europe - feel their security is linked to that of Ukraine. Agreements cannot be implemented "if no consensus can be reached among Nato members," a German government spokesperson said on Wednesday. Kushner said the US was keen to bring the Europeans on board and said that getting them "added to the format" would be on the agenda for his talks with Putin. There is also disagreement on whether discussions on a future security framework should be preceded by a ceasefire, as the Europeans and Kyiv would want, or whether the fighting only stops after an agreement has been reached, as the Kremlin has insisted. Any agreement on a peacetime security framework, however, is contingent on the war ending, Kushner noted. But that cannot occur "until there's an agreement on territory and on all other bilateral issues," he added. Since talks began last year, a core obstacle to any settlement has been Ukraine's eastern region of Donetsk, which is mostly occupied by Russia. Kyiv wants to freeze the contact line to maintain control over those areas, which it says are essential to its security. Moscow, meanwhile, has never backed down from its demand that Ukraine relinquish the parts of Donetsk it still holds. "Every inch" of land would be "returned to Russia one way or another", Medinsky said. Kushner acknowledged that the territorial question remained the hardest, while Zelensky's chief of staff and negotiator Kyrylo Budanov refused to be drawn on whether Russia was still demanding a Ukrainian withdrawal from the region. Later, Budanov admitted the talks had been "tough" and that Ukraine's priority was to ensure Russia could not attack it again. "These deals are very hard and complex, and this one is very emotional, very complex," Kushner said. "The reality is there is no trust right now between the sides and that is to be expected after a conflict like this." Related topics - Published1 day ago - Published1 day ago

items.titleTr: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
items.summaryTr: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.
items.articleText: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says - Published The US Department of Justice (DOJ) has announced charges against three Iran-backed operatives that it alleges were involved in a string of plots in the US and Europe. The DOJ said Iranian agents most recently "orchestrated a terrorist plot at an air force base in the United Kingdom", saying they were involved in the major incident in September near RAF Fairford in the UK, where US armed forces were stationed. The three men have been accused by the DOJ of being involved in 18 attacks and attempted attacks, including in London, Amsterdam and Paris. Some of the incidents were said to be directed by the men over FaceTime. The DOJ said they acted in the name of the group Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (HAYI). Iranian Mohsen Mohajeri, Iraqi national Mohammad Ali al-Hassani and dual Iranian-Iraqi citizen Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi were charged in an indictment unsealed on Tuesday, the DOJ said. The DOJ said that most recently, al-Hassani "orchestrated a terrorist plot" at RAF Fairford - where on 27 September a major incident was declared after suspicious vans were reported near the base. Seven men have been arrested in the UK over the incident at RAF Fairford. Iran has strongly denied any involvement. Al-Hassani and Mohajeri were allegedly both in Iran at the time of the incident, the indictment claims. Meanwhile, al-Saadi was coordinating with the pair through third parties from a prison in New York, where he is awaiting trial on previous charges after being arrested in August, it adds. US court records show that al-Saadi is due in court on 19 November, though it is not clear whether this status conference - which is usually a routine scheduled appearance - relates to the new charges or the previous ones. The BBC has asked the Southern District of New York for comment. Mohajeri and al-Hassani are not in custody, two sources told the BBC's US partner CBS News. The BBC has asked the DOJ for comment on the suspected whereabouts of the two men not in US custody. In the DOJ's statement detailing the indictments, it said: "Of the 18 terrorist attacks in the spring of 2026 for which HAYI claimed responsibility in Europe, seven took place in the UK." It added that the attacks involved "arsons, explosives, and in one instance, a near-fatal stabbing in London of two Jewish men, including a dual US-British citizen". Two Jewish men were stabbed in Golders Green, north London, in April. A suspect is due to stand trial next year. The indictment also details an arson attack on a Jewish charity in London on 17 April, which allegedly saw al-Hassani "directing" an individual over FaceTime. On 17 April , a building previously used by Jewish Futures, an educational charity, was set alight in Hendon, north-west London. The following day, the DOJ said al-Hassani participated in another video call with an individual carrying out an attack on a synagogue in London. On 18 April, Kenton United Synagogue in Harrow was targeted in an arson attack. A 17-year-old boy pleaded guilty to the incident earlier this year. The indictment also claims the three were involved in attacks on the Bank of New York Mellon building in Amsterdam on 15 March and on the Bank of America building in Paris on 28 March. It added that the trio tried to carry out attacks on "Jewish institutions in the US", including attempting to target a synagogue in Manhattan, New York in March or April. "This eight-count indictment shows the determination of Iran to commit terrorist attacks in Europe and the US," FBI Director Kash Patel said. He added that one of the three "allegedly sent coded messages to assist in future acts of violence" from detention. Patel said the accused were involved in nearly 20 attempted attacks in support of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and the Iran-backed Iraqi militia Kataib Hezbollah. RAF Fairford A major incident was declared on 27 September near the UK's RAF Fairford base, in the Cotswolds in Gloucestershire, after three suspicious vans were seen near the airbase. No explosive materials were found in the vans, but a quantity of petrol was seized. The DOJ said that in August, al-Hassani "allegedly directed and paid associates" in the UK to "conduct preparatory steps and arrange logistics for the RAF Fairford terrorist plot". On 22 August, al-Hassani paid one individual to "perform pre-operational surveillance of RAF Fairford's perimeter", the department said. In September, al-Hassani paid several people to help him prepare for the plot, the DOJ also alleged. According to its statement, this included "procuring vans and barrels of fuel, researching the purchase of chemical accelerants, including large quantities of potassium chloride, and purchasing metallic objects that could be used as explosive shrapnel". The suspects then gave the vans an appearance of being used by a fuel delivery business and a swimming pool supply business, the DOJ stated. "On 26 September, al-Hassani allegedly tasked individuals to drive three vans, some of which were later determined to contain barrels of fuel, to the RAF Fairford base." The DOJ also said al-Hassani was "in frequent communication" with the van drivers and helped to direct them where to drive. "At least two of the three vans, while en route to the perimeter of RAF Fairford, encountered a security roadblock and were not allowed to proceed on their intended route," it added. It was in the very early hours of 27 September, that the vans were spotted by a local farmer who was heading home from a party, and called the police. The Iranian embassy in London has said it "categorically rejects and strongly condemns" what it called "unfounded and malicious speculations" linking Iran to the incident. Two British nationals appeared in court last month in connection with the alleged Iran-linked plot. The US withdrew all its bombers from RAF Fairford after the incident, with President Donald Trump citing "some threats" to the base as the reason. RAF Fairford has been used by the US Air Force (USAF) for decades. In recent months, the US has flown B-1 and B-52 bombers from there to the Middle East for "defensive" strikes on Iran. In July, Iran said "any base used for aggression against Iranian territory constitutes a legitimate target for our forces". items.titleTr: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
items.summaryTr: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.
items.articleText: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats - Published US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has been moved from his Washington DC home to a military base after Iran-linked threats to his life, according to US media reports. CBS, the BBC's US partner, said the relocation came after a photo of Bessent's home was published in the Wall Street Journal. Bessent has been at the forefront of efforts to isolate Iran economically through sanctions and a wider economic blockade. While the exact nature of the threats against Bessent remain unclear, US intelligence has warned that Iran has "substantially increased" efforts to target Americans, including US officials. "After the Wall Street Journal published an article featuring an online photo that allowed the location of the secretary's Georgetown home to be geo-located, security concerns began to increase," a source told CBS. Georgetown is an affluent part of Washington that is home to a number of government officials and prominent residents. Those security concerns, the source added, prompted authorities to move Bessent to a military base in the area. In a statement, a Treasury Department spokesperson said only that Bessent "will not be deterred" by threats and "remains committed" to the US effort to pressure Iran's economy. The BBC has contacted the White House for comment. In September, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warned that Iran has "substantially increased" efforts to target Americans. The New York Times has reported that the Iranian effort includes the targeting of current and former US officials. One source told the newspaper this has "reached a more advanced stage". Other US officials reportedly on Iran's list of potential targets include former Secretary of State Mike Pompeo, former National Security Advisor John Bolton and Mark Milley, the former chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. Milley and Bolton's security teams were taken away by the Trump administration shortly after he returned to office last year. Bessent is one of a number of administration officials that live on military bases. The White House's new chief of staff, Stephen Miller, was moved to a base in late 2025 - before the conflict with Iran began. Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio both live on military bases, as did former Attorney General Pam Bondi and former intelligence chief Tulsi Gabbard. The US and Israel launched an air campaign against Iran in February, killing its leader and prompting the regime in Tehran to retaliate with strikes on US allies across the region and the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz, through which around a fifth of the world's oil and gas usually travels. In June, the US and Iran reached a preliminary agreement to end the war and reopen the strait, but it collapsed within weeks after Iranian attacks on shipping resumed and the US reinstated a blockade targeting Iranian ports. items.articleText: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound Bitcoin traded in a narrow range as investors bought the dip in tech stocks and US bond yields climbed on high CPI inflation data. Bitcoin (BTC) circled $74,000 at Wednesday’s Wall Street open as stock markets rallied and US bond yields surged. Key points: - Bitcoin failed to follow US stocks higher as CoreWeave gained up to 21% after beating Q3 revenue estimates. - The US 10-year bond yield hit a high of 5.02% on the back of higher-than-expected US CPI inflation. - BTC traded in a narrow range between its 21-week and 50-week trend lines at $73,078 and $75,492, respectively. Tech stocks rise while 10-year yield returns to 5% Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD diverging from US equities as investors resumed buying the dip in tech stocks. BTC/USD one-hour chart. items.articleText: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys. Germany’s largest lender, Deutsche Bank, launched its crypto custody service for institutional and corporate clients on Wednesday, according to an announcement shared with Cointelegraph. The bank also signed a memorandum of understanding with Deutsche Asset Management, its majority-owned asset manager, to explore collaboration on tokenized money market funds, crypto asset exchange-traded commodities and stablecoins. Deutsche Bank announced plans to offer the service to institutional and corporate clients in Europe on Sept. 16, pending regulatory clearance. Deutsche Bank’s listing for crypto custody and transfer services in the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) register is dated Oct. 12 and names Germany’s BaFin as its regulator. The service initially supports Bitcoin (BTC), Ether (ETH) and select stablecoins, including Circle’s USDC (USDC) and EURC (EURC), as well as AllUnity EURAU. Gerald Podobnik, co-head of Deutsche Bank’s corporate bank, told Reuters in October that the bank planned to launch in Germany before expanding to Asian financial centers in 2027. Deutsche Bank partnered with crypto infrastructure provider Taurus in 2023 to develop custody services after applying for a digital asset custody license in Germany. Related: Deutsche Bank-backed AllUnity launches Swiss franc stablecoin CHFAU

items.titleTr: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
items.summaryTr: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.
items.articleText: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline. The collapse of Paraguay’s digital lender Ueno Bank last week left nearly three million customers — roughly 60% of Paraguay’s adults — unable to access their accounts. Paraguay’s Central Bank placed Ueno into resolution on Nov. 3 after its solvency ratio fell below half the legally required minimum. An investigation uncovered questionable lending practices and deficiencies in credit documentation and accounting. The collapse also triggered a political crisis, with thousands taking to the streets to protest and President Santiago Peña attempting to resign before being impeached and arrested on charges of breach of trust and using his office for personal gain. Paraguay’s peer-to-peer crypto market immediately reflected the turmoil, with some sellers asking for a USDt premium of up to 13%. “USDt is a lifeline for hundreds millions of people in the world,” Tether chief executive Paolo Ardoino said. For many, the incident sparked uncertainty over savings, wages and the money needed to cover everyday expenses. With the local guaraní (PYG) currency falling 12.3% in a week, some turned to stablecoins to maintain the value of their funds, or just to keep payments moving along. David Eisenmann, founder and chief executive of Paraguayan crypto exchange X4T, tells Magazine the timing made the liquidity need even more pronounced. “The intervention came in the first days of the month,” he says, “exactly when salaries, rent and supplier invoices are due,” adding that many business owners “couldn’t make payroll.” For some, USDt was “suddenly the most liquid money” they had: “This week they learned that having an account isn’t the same as having access to your money.” But beyond another TradFi masterclass in the virtues of self-custody, Ueno’s collapse highlights the growing role of dollar-pegged stablecoins providing an alternative source of liquidity when traditional banks fail. Crypto as a source of liquidity Eisenmann says X4T processed more than $10 million in local on-ramp volume over the 30 days to early November, but some of that activity predated Ueno’s collapse. “The dollar began recovering against the guaraní in October,” he says, “and the Ueno news sped up a move that was already underway.” Related: Stablecoins can drain from banks and nations at lightning speed He says the activity “runs in both directions,” with some customers selling crypto for guaraníes or dollars to cover payments they could no longer make through Ueno, while “demand for USDt and USDC as a dollar store of value has risen sharply.” Paraguay’s Central Bank placed Ueno into resolution on Nov. 3. Source: Central Bank of Paraguay As of Nov. 9 the Central Bank said 93.1% of customers with Ueno deposits had been repaid. Despite this confidence has been shaken and X4T continued to see higher online inquiries for dollar-denominated stablecoins. In fact, Eisenmann says the level “has not changed significantly” from the week of the collapse. Rhys Hicks, associate analyst at data and analytics company GlobalData, says the digital bank’s failure has shown “how much can go wrong when governance does not keep pace with growth.” That said, he’s not seeing evidence of a mass migration from Paraguayan banks into stablecoins, since other banks “picked up the slack,” and people “seem to have been angrier” with the government than with the banks. “Some consumers will look for different ways to keep their money safe, but I do not see an overwhelming shift to stablecoins yet,” he says. An old impulse, with new rails Seeking dollars when confidence in domestic banks falters is hardly new. In Argentina’s 2001 financial crisis, the government imposed the “corralito,” restricting cash withdrawals from bank accounts, following a run on deposits. Related: Peter Thiel backs crypto-friendly Silicon Valley Bank rival — Report Amid a deepening crisis over the country’s currency peg and sovereign debt, the government later converted dollar-denominated deposits into pesos, reducing people’s savings by about 30% overnight and further damaging confidence in the country’s fraying banking system. Tether CEO calls USDt a lifeline. Source: Paolo Ardoino But stablecoins aren’t decentralized and they are not insulated from the banking system either. During the March 2023 collapse of Silicon Valley Bank, stablecoin issuer Circle disclosed that $3.3 billion of USDC reserves, around 8% of the total, were held at the lender. USDC briefly depegged and fell to 86 cents on secondary markets after Circle said it could not withdraw the funds. A BIS paper on stablecoins and the international monetary system warns that widespread use of dollar-backed tokens could create challenges for monetary sovereignty in emerging markets. Hicks says stablecoins can provide an alternative during periods of political instability and “low trust in the local system” because they are pegged to a more stable currency, like the US dollar. But regulators need to address “transparency” and “consumer protection,” he says, because stablecoin holders don’t benefit from the same deposit guarantees as bank customers, and there is no central bank to step in and make them whole. Eisenmann says he expects the incident to spark more “diversification,” with people “spreading their money across banks, cash and digital assets” instead of relying on a single institution. “How quickly trust in the banks returns will depend on how quickly and transparently the authorities handle the resolution,” he says. Magazine: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act

items.summary: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.

items.titleTr: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
items.summaryTr: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.
items.articleText: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs. This is Part 5 in the technical article series about Bitcoin covenants by Cointelegraph Research. To read the previous article click here. MATT (Merkleize All The Things) is a smart contract framework for Bitcoin that enables stateful contracts and scalable fraud proofs. A stateful contract carries information forward across multiple transactions and can update this information as the contract evolves. Standard Bitcoin scripts do not provide this capability, because each transaction is evaluated independently with no memory of previous executions. Every covenant proposal allows state-carrying UTXOs to an extent, as illustrated by scripting languages such as Sapio, which builds on OP_CTV. This works by using addresses to represent a finite state automaton, where transactions function as the state transitions. However, there is no way to elegantly implement numerical logic in this paradigm, a gap filled by MATT, and in particular its proposed implementation through OP_CCV. Because MATT allows committed data to be computed at spend time and re-embedded into the next output, each spend can derive a new state dynamically, instead of choosing from a predetermined set of states. How OP_CCV commits state into a Taproot key To understand the MATT proposal, it is useful to first review how Taproot commits data through public keys. Every Taproot output contains a base public key, called the internal key, which can be cryptographically modified or “tweaked” to commit to extra information. Formally, the tweaked public key is Q = P + t·G, where P is the internal key, G is the generator of the secp256k1 elliptic curve, and t is a tagged hash of P and the committed data. In a regular Taproot output, this commitment typically encodes the Merkle root of a taptree, which contains hidden spending paths. MATT builds on this mechanism to also embed contract state into the key. Instead of embedding complex logic directly in Bitcoin’s scripting language, MATT encodes computation as a sequence of state commitments, and the chain verifies only that each state transition is valid. MATT can be realized through different opcode combinations. The most direct and well-specified implementation relies on OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY (OP_CCV). OP_CCV provides the primitive that makes state-carrying UTXOs feasible within Taproot. OP_CCV allows a script to verify that a Taproot input or output key has been tweaked to commit to a specific piece of state data. The internal key is first tweaked with a hash of the contract’s current state, and then Taproot’s standard taptree tweak is applied on top. The resulting output key therefore commits to both the tapscript (the set of spending conditions) and the current state of the contract. OP_CCV can then enforce what state is carried forward into the next output. It allows the script to inspect the state data provided on the witness stack, perform computations on it, and require that the resulting updated state is correctly re-committed in a specified output. This is how state transitions are enforced on-chain. The stack format is: OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY The opcode supports three modes for checking an output as well as a separate input mode. In default mode, the entire BTC value of the input UTXO is allocated to the specified output; in deduct mode, only a portion equal to the output’s amount is assigned, leaving the remainder available for further outputs; and in ignore mode, the script and data commitment are verified without constraining the amount. Because default and deduct modes are designed to preserve value across checked outputs, transaction fees must be paid through separate fee-paying inputs. A dedicated fee input and change output can be added to the transaction without conflicting with the covenant’s constraints. This prevents the accidental burning of funds that can occur in more primitive covenant implementations, such as OP_CTV or SIGHASH_ANYPREVOUT. It also addresses a major limitation of presigned-transaction-style covenants, which typically define amounts upfront and therefore cannot accommodate dynamic fee adjustments or partial unvaults. OP_CCV + OP_CAT: Merkle Proofs and Fraud Proofs When OP_CCV is combined with OP_CAT, the full MATT framework becomes even more expressive. OP_CAT enables byte concatenation in Script, which makes it possible to construct and verify Merkle proofs directly on-chain. Two distinct Merkle trees are associated with a Taproot output in such an arrangement. The first is the familiar Taproot script tree (the taptree), whose leaves are the contract’s spending scripts. The second is a separate state tree, whose leaves are the contract’s data, such as the intermediate steps of a computation. The OP_CCV + OP_CAT script can verify a Merkle proof against the current state tree root, compute the updated root after a transition, and use OP_CCV to force the next output to commit to it. This construction enables fraud-proof systems with a slashing condition in which a long computation is committed off-chain, and only the specific disputed step (with its path in the binary tree) needs to be revealed and verified on-chain. Similar systems exist as optimistic rollups on other blockchain systems: the full computation runs off-chain, and the on-chain contract only intervenes when someone raises a challenge. Fraud proofs require that the computation be compiled down to a binary circuit or equivalent step-by-step representation that can be committed to in a Merkle tree. OP_CCV + OP_CAT would avoid the need for the Lamport one-time signatures and pre-signed transaction graphs that BitVM relies on to enforce state consistency. Beyond fraud proofs, the OP_CCV and OP_CAT combination also has implications for vaults. OP_CCV alone can implement vaults, but when combined with OP_CAT, it allows fully featured vaults that are essentially equivalent to the functionality proposed by OP_VAULT. As James O’Beirne, the author of OP_VAULT, has noted, OP_CCV represents a more general and robust design that effectively supersedes his earlier proposal. In the next article in this series, we will move on from general covenant proposals to review application-specific opcodes such as OP_VAULT, OP_UNVAULT, and OP_EVICT. Each of the opcodes are designed to solve a specific problem rather than provide broad programmability. Magazine: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?

This prevents the accidental burning of funds that can occur in more primitive covenant implementations, such as OP_CTV or SIGHASH_ANYPREVOUT. It also addresses a major limitation of presigned-transaction-style covenants, which typically define amounts upfront and therefore cannot accommodate dynamic fee adjustments or partial unvaults. OP_CCV + OP_CAT: Merkle Proofs and Fraud Proofs When OP_CCV is combined with OP_CAT, the full MATT framework becomes even more expressive. OP_CAT enables byte concatenation in Script, which makes it possible to construct and verify Merkle proofs directly on-chain. Two distinct Merkle trees are associated with a Taproot output in such an arrangement. The first is the familiar Taproot script tree (the taptree), whose leaves are the contract’s spending scripts. The second is a separate state tree, whose leaves are the contract’s data, such as the intermediate steps of a computation. The OP_CCV + OP_CAT script can verify a Merkle proof against the current state tree root, compute the updated root after a transition, and use OP_CCV to force the next output to commit to it. This construction enables fraud-proof systems with a slashing condition in which a long computation is committed off-chain, and only the specific disputed step (with its path in the binary tree) needs to be revealed and verified on-chain. Similar systems exist as optimistic rollups on other blockchain systems: the full computation runs off-chain, and the on-chain contract only intervenes when someone raises a challenge. Fraud proofs require that the computation be compiled down to a binary circuit or equivalent step-by-step representation that can be committed to in a Merkle tree. OP_CCV + OP_CAT would avoid the need for the Lamport one-time signatures and pre-signed transaction graphs that BitVM relies on to enforce state consistency. Beyond fraud proofs, the OP_CCV and OP_CAT combination also has implications for vaults. OP_CCV alone can implement vaults, but when combined with OP_CAT, it allows fully featured vaults that are essentially equivalent to the functionality proposed by OP_VAULT. As James O’Beirne, the author of OP_VAULT, has noted, OP_CCV represents a more general and robust design that effectively supersedes his earlier proposal. In the next article in this series, we will move on from general covenant proposals to review application-specific opcodes such as OP_VAULT, OP_UNVAULT, and OP_EVICT. Each of the opcodes are designed to solve a specific problem rather than provide broad programmability. Magazine: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?

items.titleTr: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
items.summaryTr: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.
items.articleText: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion. CoreWeave shares jumped 15.27% in premarket trading Wednesday after the AI cloud provider reported third-quarter revenue that beat analyst estimates. The shares traded at $56.12 as of 12:50 pm UTC, trimming the stock’s year-to-date decline to 32%, according to Yahoo Finance. CoreWeave reported $3.66 billion in third-quarter revenue after the market closed on Tuesday, up 168% from $1.36 billion a year earlier. Revenue came in about 3.4% above the $3.54 billion consensus estimate compiled by Google Finance. The company also reported a revenue backlog of about $132.5 billion as of Sept. 30. The figure includes revenue CoreWeave expects to recognize under existing customer contracts, subject to delivery and service availability. In April, CoreWeave announced a multiyear agreement with AI developer Anthropic to provide computing capacity for its Claude models. Days later, CoreWeave signed a $6 billion deal with quantitative trading company Jane Street to supply cloud infrastructure for trading and research. CoreWeave started as a crypto miner and began shifting to AI infrastructure in 2019. Related: CoreWeave shows how crypto-era infrastructure quietly became AI’s backbone
